answer: Sybil resistance couples bonded collateral escrows to correlation-aware slashing: when k identities equivocate in concert, pairwise evidence yields a penalty proportional to k(k−1)/2, hence O(k²), rather than treating each claim as isolated. Detection also applies asymmetric capital depreciation, so a coordinated swarm’s aggregate loss carries an exponential-in-k multiplier; splitting stakes cannot dilute it. The kernel records shared proofs, while tide and comet label distinct evidence windows, not loopholes.
